project.name: MarketWatch — Multi-Source Market Watchlist
project.description: Comprehensive real-time financial market analytics platform aggregating stocks, perpetuals, crypto, forex, and indices across Hyperliquid, Yahoo Finance, Binance, OKX, and BingX with WebAssembly acceleration and native Android WebView integration.

tour.title: 1. Project Overview & Architecture
tour.description: MarketWatch aggregates live financial data from Yahoo Finance, Hyperliquid, Binance, OKX, and BingX. Start with CONTEXT.md and AGENTS.md for full design decisions and conventions.

tour.title: 2. Landing Page & Design System
tour.description: The public welcome dashboard (app/page.tsx) uses Tailwind v4, Geist fonts, glassmorphic card designs, and a live streaming ticker marquee.

tour.title: 3. WebAssembly Performance Engine
tour.description: High-performance AssemblyScript module compiled to WebAssembly (assembly/index.ts) executing Kalman filters, RSI, SMA, and Black-Scholes Greeks with zero-overhead JS fallback (lib/wasm/loader.ts).

tour.title: 4. Watchlist State & Synchronization
tour.description: The useWatchlist hook manages guest mode (localStorage) and authenticated cloud synchronization with Supabase PostgreSQL tables.

tour.title: 5. Multi-Source Price API Proxies
tour.description: Server-side Next.js route handlers in app/api/prices/ safely proxy data from Hyperliquid, Yahoo Finance, Binance, OKX, and BingX without exposing secrets or triggering CORS issues.

tour.title: 6. Advanced Charts & Order Flow
tour.description: TradingView Lightweight Charts candlestick workspace coupled with live Level 2 order books and real-time aggressor trade flow and wall tracking.

tour.title: 7. Quantitative Signals & Options GEX
tour.description: Multi-timeframe statistical signals (Kalman filters, momentum, CVD proxy) and options Gamma Exposure analytics (Call/Put walls, Max Pain, Gamma Flip points).

tour.title: 8. Native Android WebView & Deep Links
tour.description: Native Android container wrapping the web application with hardware acceleration, background notification bridges, and OAuth callback handling.
